title: Read-only workspace validation service
body: A read-only workspace validation service uses a versioned rule registry and a shared result contract with rule code/version, severity, entity kind, workspace identity, record IDs, evidence, remediation, run timestamp, duration, and summary counts.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Result contract has rule code/version, severity, entity kind, workspace identity, record IDs, evidence, remediation, run timestamp, duration, summary counts.
Registry is versioned; unknown rule code is not silently skipped.
